title: Introduce service-scoped access lifespans and audit-entropy gate
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Customers asked for stricter temporal controls on operator/service credentials and lower-risk audit emission in high-cardinality paths. This PR introduces two coordinated features: 1) service-scoped access lifespans (short-lived RBAC bindings) to limit long-lived grants and make per-request elevations timebound; 2) an audit-entropy gate that adds deterministic sampling and hashed anchors for high-cardinality audit streams to reduce leakage and downstream storage costs while preserving verifiable integrity. The change touches the RBAC v2 evaluation pipeline, the operator credential issuance flow, the audit-forwarder, and rollout flags.

What this includes: - A new AccessLifespan policy object (schema + validator) that can be attached to service and operator role bindings. Lifespan supports absolute expiry and sliding windows (TTL + max-extensions). - RBAC evaluator changes to enforce lifespan both at decision-time and during cached binding material refreshes (evict/refresh logic). - A short-lived token issuance path (service-lease) that signs ephemeral grants and publishes lease metadata to the audit stream. - Audit-entropy gate middleware added to the audit-forwarder: identifies high-cardinality channels (e.g., request headers, user-supplied metadata), computes a per-tenant entropy score, applies deterministic sampling policies, and emits a compact audit anchor (sha256-based) for every sampled event. Anchors are stored in the audit-index with a retention pointer for later verification. - Feature flags and config knobs: rbac.access_lifespan.enabled (beta), audit.entropy_gate.mode (off|sample|strict), audit.entropy_gate.threshold per-tenant override. - Migration and compatibility: existing role bindings without AccessLifespan default to unlimited (no change). The evaluator logs a deprecation hint for bindings older than 1y when feature flag is on. - Testing: unit tests for evaluator, integration harness additions for token rotation, e2e for audit anchors and verification.

Rollout plan: 1) Feature gated behind rbac.access_lifespan.enabled=false and audit.entropy_gate.mode=off by default. 2) Gradual rollout on Dedicated clusters with opt-in tenant flag for 2 weeks. 3) Canary on hosted API for low-volume customers; monitor: rbac.evaluation.latency, authz.cache-miss-rate, audit.sample-rate, audit-anchor-verify-failures. 4) If stable after 2 weeks, flip default to sample mode with conservative threshold and enable beta program.

Checklist: - [x] Schema and validation code for AccessLifespan - [x] Enforcer changes and cache eviction hooks - [x] Short-lived token path + signer integration - [x] Audit-forwarder entropy gate implementation - [x] Unit/integration tests added - [x] Feature flags and config docs - [x] Linear tickets (ENG-9342) linked - [x] Reviewed and approved by security and SRE

Backwards compatibility notes: No breaking changes to existing bindings; operators that rely on long-lived tokens should migrate to the service-lease path. Customers can opt-out by leaving feature flags off. Audit anchors are additive and do not change existing audit formats when sampling is off.
commits: feat(rbac): add AccessLifespan proto and validator
feat(authz): enforce lifespan at decision-time and add cache eviction hook
feat(audit): implement entropy gate and anchor encoder; add sampling config
review_conversation: Marcus Lee (reviewer): Can we avoid adding synchronous network calls from the evaluator path? Suggest we keep any calls async and rely on lease metadata TTL for correctness.
Priya Nair (author): Good catch — updated evaluator to use local cache + background refresher; lease metadata is authoritative and used for hard decisions.
Anika Patel (reviewer): We need to ensure the entropy scoring is deterministic across restarts for verification. Use stable hashing with tenant salt stored in config.
Priya Nair (author): Implemented stable tenant salt and added test to assert deterministic anchor for identical inputs across process restarts.
Diego Ruiz (reviewer): Add observability for dropped events and a breakdown by reason (entropy-threshold, rate-limit, malformed).
Priya Nair (author): Added rbac.audit.dropped_count metric with labels and updated dashboards.
release_notes: Added AccessLifespan RBAC policy and an audit-entropy gate. Feature is beta-gated. Introduces short-lived service leases to reduce long-lived credentials and deterministic audit anchors for sampled events. See configuration docs for opt-in and thresholds.
qa_notes: QA exercised canary flow with 3 tenants. Verified lifespan enforcement, token rotation, and anchor verification; monitored authz cache behavior under load. No regressions in mainline authz latencies observed in canary.
postmerge_tasks: Enable feature flag for internal Dedicated cluster (opt-in tenants)
Announce beta and migration guide to customers
Prepare SDK docs for short-lived token usage
